title: The Great Commission
definition: The Great Commission is Christ's command to make disciples of all nations by going, baptizing, and teaching obedience to His Word.
summary: The Great Commission is Christ's command to make disciples of all nations by going, baptizing, and teaching obedience to Him.
christFocus: Jesus Christ sends His Church with all authority and promises His presence to the end of the age.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine is rooted in the risen authority of Jesus. The command is not merely to gain decisions but to make disciples who are baptized and taught to obey all that Christ commanded. It gives the Church a clear task until the end of the age.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because mission can become vague without Christ's commission. The Great Commission keeps evangelism, baptism, teaching, and obedience joined together. It also gives confidence because the One who commands also promises His presence.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Measure ministry by disciple-making faithfulness, not merely activity. Pray for all nations and for specific people who need Christ. Teach new believers to obey Jesus, not simply to identify with Christianity.
